item.title: Sierra tandem ends season strong at state cross country meet
item.description: Making his third appearance in the California Interscholastic Federation State Championships on Saturday, Sierra senior Christian Gonzalez shaved more than 15 seconds off of his previous best time at Woodward Park in Fresno.

item.title: ROUNDUP: Buffs kick off girls soccer season with comfortable win
item.description: The Manteca girls soccer team had five different goal scorers Monday, opening its non-league schedule with a 5-2 win over visiting Escalon.

item.title: Akca’s late goal lifts Sierra over Ripon
item.description: Ripon and Sierra showed the usual early-season rust in a non-league match on Monday, but coaches from both sides came away encouraged. Aydkin Akca’s late goal was the difference for visiting Sierra, which escaped with a 2-1 victory.

item.title: Steyer gets rich off coal & oil, becomes a climate warrior, now running for governor
item.description: Tom Steyer is running for Governor of California. And he’s channeling New York Mayor-Elect Zohran Mamdani. To quote Steyer. “The richest people in America think they earned everything themselves, That’s bull - - - -.”

item.title: RIPON TREE LIGHTING
item.description: Sandy Stoddard was impressed with the community-wide gathering at the Tree Lighting Ceremony Monday in Ripon.

item.title: San Joaquin County Spelling Bee now underway
item.description: The 28h annual San Joaquin County Spelling Bee is scheduled this week at the Wentworth Education Center, 2707 Transworld Drive, Stockton.

item.title: London Avenue speed lumps before council
item.description: Two more sets of speed lumps are coming to the streets of Manteca. This time it is on London Avenue between Genoa Drive and Nicol Way in northwest Manteca.

item.title: Two tree lightings & Christmas at the Center Wednesday
item.description: The holiday season in Manteca officially gets underway with two tree lightings and Christmas at the Center on Wednesday. And it continues Saturday with the downtown twilight parade and Christmas in the Park. m

item.description: Jim Shoemaker announced Monday he is seeking the California District Assembly 9 in the 2026 election cycle. s.

item.title: GROWTH FEES WILL HELP PAY FOR AIRPORT WAY WIDENING
item.description: Manteca — as of June 30 — had in excess of $218 million in growth fees collected to help fund dozens upon dozens of identified infrastructure projects and major equipment purchases.
